latest_release.body:
# Dapr 1.19.1

This update contains the following bug fixes and improvements:
- [Sidecar leaked connections while the Placement service was unreachable](#sidecar-leaked-connections-while-the-placement-service-was-unreachable)
- [SQLite state store writes failed with `database is locked` after a cancelled read](#sqlite-state-store-writes-failed-with-database-is-locked-after-a-cancelled-read)
- [Security: Service invocation access control bypass with other percent-encoded characters and path parameters](#security-service-invocation-access-control-bypass-with-other-percent-encoded-characters-and-path-parameters)
- [Security: Scheduler delivered another app's workflow reminders to any app in the namespace](#security-scheduler-delivered-another-apps-workflow-reminders-to-any-app-in-the-namespace)
- [Security: API token check bypassed with a percent-encoded health check path](#security-api-token-check-bypassed-with-a-percent-encoded-health-check-path)
- [Security: Sidecars relayed proxied gRPC calls from other sidecars under their own identity](#security-sidecars-relayed-proxied-grpc-calls-from-other-sidecars-under-their-own-identity)
- [Security: Scheduler prefix delete removed other apps' jobs](#security-scheduler-prefix-delete-removed-other-apps-jobs)
- [Security: Public port accepted unauthenticated, unbounded metadata writes](#security-public-port-accepted-unauthenticated-unbounded-metadata-writes)
- [Security: Sentry OIDC discovery document poisonable via `X-Forwarded-Host` with an allowed hosts list](#security-sentry-oidc-discovery-document-poisonable-via-x-forwarded-host-with-an-allowed-hosts-list)
- [Security: Malformed encrypted state values crashed the sidecar](#security-malformed-encrypted-state-values-crashed-the-sidecar)
- [Security: Outbox processed forged messages from its internal topic](#security-outbox-processed-forged-messages-from-its-internal-topic)
- [Security: gRPC servers accepted request headers far beyond the configured read buffer size](#security-grpc-servers-accepted-request-headers-far-beyond-the-configured-read-buffer-size)
- [Security: Service invocation access control ignored HTTP verb rules for requests without metadata](#security-service-invocation-access-control-ignored-http-verb-rules-for-requests-without-metadata)

## Sidecar leaked connections while the Placement service was unreachable

### Problem

While the sidecar could not reach the Placement service, it tried to connect about twice a second. Each attempt opened a new gRPC connection, and the sidecar did not close it when the attempt failed. Each leaked connection kept trying to reach Placement, with its own goroutines, until the sidecar restarted.
The sidecar also did not close the connection when a stream to Placement ended.

### Impact

You were affected if a sidecar could not reach the Placement service for a sustained period, for example while its pods restarted or crash looped. The goroutine count and memory use of every sidecar that connects to Placement grew for as long as the outage lasted. In a test with Placement stopped, the goroutine count of the sidecar grew by about 8 every second. Restarting the sidecar released the connections.

### Root Cause

The sidecar dials a connection to a Placement host and then opens the Placement stream on it. The dial does not wait for the host, so it succeeds while Placement is down, and only opening the stream fails.
When opening the stream failed, the sidecar returned the error without closing the connection, and the retry loop dialed another one. When a stream ended, the sidecar cancelled the stream but did not close its connection.

### Solution

The sidecar closes the connection when opening the stream fails, and closes it when the stream ends.
